name: nestjs
description: NestJS — modular framework with decorator-driven controllers and dependency injection. Decorator order on a handler: @UseGuards (guard) → @UseInterceptors (interceptor) → @UsePipes (pipe) → route handler.

decoratorSemantics.@Controller: route controller — class-level, defines the route prefix
decoratorSemantics.@All: route handler for any HTTP method
decoratorSemantics.@UseGuards: applies a guard (authorization) to a controller or handler
decoratorSemantics.@UseInterceptors: applies an interceptor (request lifecycle) to a controller or handler
decoratorSemantics.@Injectable: injectable provider — service unless it implements a lifecycle interface
decoratorSemantics.@Body: binds the request body to a handler parameter
decoratorSemantics.@Param: binds a route parameter to a handler parameter
decoratorSemantics.@Query: binds the query string to a handler parameter
decoratorSemantics.@Headers: binds request headers to a handler parameter
decoratorSemantics.@EventPattern: event handler for the event-driven transport
decoratorSemantics.@MessagePattern: message handler for the message-driven transport
